name: account_access
description: Login failures, password reset, 2FA/backup codes, business account setup. Not unauthorized access.

name: security_account_compromise
description: Unauthorized login, account breach, suspicious activity, fraud on the account.

name: phishing_abuse_report
description: Reporting phishing, spoofed emails, or abuse -- not their own account issue.

name: billing_subscription
description: Charges, refunds, invoices, plan pricing, upgrades/downgrades, account closure, data deletion.

name: storage_quota_plan_limits
description: Account storage/quota full or plan storage limits (not device disk usage).

name: sync_app_bug
description: Files not syncing, upload/download failures, app or website crashes/errors.

name: service_outage
description: "Is Dropbox down?" -- service-wide outage, not one user's bug.

name: sharing_permissions
description: Shared folders/links, permissions, team folders, invite/join problems.

name: data_loss_recovery
description: Deleted or missing files, restore/version-history requests.

name: how_to_usage
description: "How do I X" or a product question -- nothing is broken.

name: feature_request
description: Suggestion or product feedback -- not a problem to fix.

name: complaint_dissatisfaction
description: Frustration, rant, churn threat, competitor comparison.

name: no_action_needed
description: Praise, thanks, spam, sales/jobs, off-topic, or too fragmentary to route.
